items.question: Do I need prior experience to work with Goodwill?
items.answer: No. We welcome newly certified HCAs as well as experienced aides. Some roles offer mentorship and hands-on orientation.

items.question: What credentials do I need?
items.answer: You’ll need to have completed a recognized Health Care Aide or Continuing Care Assistant program (e.g., Alberta HCA, CCA in Nova Scotia).

items.question: Can I choose a specific province or region?
items.answer: Yes. We work with you to match your preferred schedule, location, and travel availability.

items.question: Do you have rural and remote placements?
items.answer: Yes. We specialize in providing staff to underserved areas across Canada, with full travel and housing support.

items.question: Are bilingual HCAs in demand?
items.answer: Yes. We often place bilingual HCAs in New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, and Ontario.

blocks.html: Goodwill Staffing connects Health Care Aides with job opportunities across Canada. Whether you prefer local or travel contracts, we support your success with flexible schedules, housing, travel, and onboarding support.
